source.excerpt: Shared as a timeboxed application session for anyone whose job search has turned into an all-evening scroll.

body:
## What it does

Job hunting falls apart in two ways: the open-ended session that eats an entire evening, and the slow realisation that you have already applied to the same role twice. This gives the search a fixed sixty-minute slot and works through a stored backlog of postings, striking each one off the list as it goes. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @HaseebMir91 shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
